# Unique Tours & Travels

> Trusted travel agency based in Karur, Tamil Nadu, India. Offering affordable domestic and international tour packages since 2017.

## About
Unique Tours & Travels is a premium travel agency specializing in curated tour packages for families, couples, students, and corporate groups. Based in Karur with branches in Trichy, Namakkal, and Coimbatore. Founded in 2017, we have served over 5000 happy travelers.

## Domestic Destinations
- Kerala: Munnar, Alleppey, Thekkady, Varkala, Kovalam, Trivandrum
- Goa: Calangute, Palolem, Baga, Dudhsagar Falls
- Manali: Solang Valley, Rohtang Pass, Jogini Falls
- Kashmir: Dal Lake, Gulmarg, Pahalgam, Sonamarg
- Rajasthan: Jaipur (Amer Fort), Udaipur, Jodhpur
- Andaman & Nicobar Islands: Havelock Island, Radhanagar Beach, Baratang
- Ladakh: Pangong Lake, Nubra Valley, Khardung La
- Karnataka: Coorg, Hampi, Mysore
- Maharashtra: Lonavala, Mumbai, Mahabaleshwar
- Delhi: Red Fort, Qutub Minar, India Gate
- Lakshadweep: Agatti, Bangaram, Kavaratti

## International Destinations
- Dubai: Burj Khalifa, Desert Safari, Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah
- Maldives: Overwater Villas, Snorkeling, Island Hopping
- Bali: Rice Terraces, Temples, Ubud, Seminyak
- Singapore: Marina Bay Sands, Sentosa, Gardens by the Bay
- Thailand: Bangkok, Phuket, Pattaya, Chiang Mai
- Malaysia: Kuala Lumpur, Langkawi, Petronas Towers
- Sri Lanka: Colombo, Kandy, Sigiriya, Ella
- Indonesia: Jakarta, Yogyakarta, Komodo Island

## Services
- Student Trips: Budget-friendly group adventures
- Honeymoon Packages: Romantic and private getaways
- Family Tours: Safe, relaxing sightseeing experiences
- College Tours: Group activities and team adventures
- Farewell Trips: Memorable final getaways
- Corporate Tours: Luxury team building retreats
- Adventure Trips: Trekking, rafting, and outdoor thrills
- Weekend Getaways: Short refreshing escapes
- Summer Packages: Beat-the-heat hill station trips
- Winter Packages: Snow and mountain experiences
- Devotional Tours: Temple and spiritual journeys
- Customized Tours: Tailor-made group itineraries

## Package Inclusions
- Transport arrangements (AC/Non-AC vehicle)
- Accommodation (3 sharing basis)
- Sightseeing entry tickets
- Food & refreshments
- Campfire / activity experiences
- All taxes and service charges
- Driver allowance, fuel, toll & parking
